question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

He **took pain** to finish the task on time.
solution:
The correct answer is '**took pains**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 

• The phrase "**took pains**" is an idiomatic expression that means making a lot of effort to complete something, which fits the context of the sentence. 

• The other options do not convey the correct meaning or are grammatically incorrect in this context: 

• **Option 1: "had pain"** - This refers to physical pain an
